**Reproduced generator override defect.** `AXES["inner_position"]` declares `tl|tr|bl|br|center`, but `inner_position="br"` is realized at the top-right marker position. With seed `123`, sample index `0`, medium difficulty, the generated grid is 15×15; the expected bottom-right interior marker is `[13, 13]`, while the observed inner-color marker is `[1, 13]`. The complete input is byte-for-byte identical to the `inner_position="tr"` draw. `self_check` returns `[]`, so the defect is not rejected by the target validator. The input belongs to the documented override domain, and the canonical Racket authority was successfully applied.

This is an input-axis realization defect rather than an output-rule rival, so `rival_output` is explicitly `null`. Target generator SHA-256: `f3852992522feb56d3b0591fbdc3473035760baeca47a1c8c67ba52bca07110e`; expected rule hash: `267d0c1f4d6a`.

## 38eaf32b0d29

**A1 — Reproduced advertised input-position defect; findings only.** Generator SHA-256 `f3852992522feb56d3b0591fbdc3473035760baeca47a1c8c67ba52bca07110e`; executed canonical rule hash `267d0c1f4d6a`, exact rule-text SHA-256 `86791cafbf342e151a9daec081e7c547745ca5cba80e65542420a52f2795b96a`. Target source remains unchanged.

`AXES["inner_position"]` advertises `tl|tr|bl|br|center`. At seed 123, sample index 0, medium difficulty, `grid_size=15`, `n_outer_marks=8`, and `inner_position="br"`, the inner marker appears at zero-based `[1,13]` (top-right), rather than bottom-right `[13,13]`. The input is byte-identical to the same request with `inner_position="tr"`. Both requests use documented valid controls, and `self_check(..., difficulty="medium")` returns `[]`. `_inner_positions` has no `br` branch and falls through to the top-right location.

The reproducer uses `reviewer_support.load_selected_generator` with an explicit root. The probe and official `arcpuzzles apply` both exited 0. Racket returned one valid output under the expected rule hash for input SHA-256 `bfca4dae7ff69b0c71d7a43a521fce5b3ee1c4cd06b03f6ad4657855121d609b`; output SHA-256 `1b0262640e248dc7105d65d84ac92e9bba8996fc8b5c2e1f8652e55b81337512`. This is an input-axis defect; `rival_output` is explicitly null, and no incorrect authority label is alleged.

Evidence under `checks/audit/38eaf32b0d29/`: `probe.py`, `probe.json`, exact `input.json`, live authority receipt `racket.json`, exact command/cwd/environment/exit/console records in `commands.json`, and source-bound `summary.json`. Two generator calls yielded one unique input. This is a bounded one-seed reproduction, not a full battery or seed-space claim. Console streams were consolidated and JSON whitespace compacted to fit available storage; complete parsed evidence and receipt byte hashes are retained.

Existing same-source audits `review-0062d8f12011f0be:v0001` and `review-4fb2a93096b60c50:v0001` in `repo/generators/38eaf32b0d29/evidence/review_index.json` were used as leads. This run independently reproduces their issue on the selected current bytes. The finding remains unresolved; no audited source, rule, approval or training status changed.
